name: rule-card
title: Operational rule card
for_each: select id,name from rules order by name

sections.title: Owner and purpose
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,review_due from rules where id=$1

sections.title: Approved decision definition
sections.sql:
select v.version, v.definition->>'strategy' as matching_order, row_number() over() as row,
 coalesce((select string_agg((c->>'field') || ' ' || (case c->>'op' when 'eq' then 'equals' when 'ne' then 'does not equal' when 'gte' then 'at least' when 'gt' then 'greater than' when 'lt' then 'less than' when 'lte' then 'at most' else c->>'op' end) || ' ' || (c->>'value'),' AND ') from jsonb_array_elements(line->'conditions') c),'Always') as when,
 (select string_agg(key || ': ' || value,', ') from jsonb_each_text(line->'output')) as result,
 v.approver as reviewed_by
 from rule_versions v join rules r on r.active_version_id=v.id cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(v.definition->'rows') line where r.id=$1

sections.title: Regression examples
sections.sql:
select name,(select string_agg(key || ': ' || value,', ') from jsonb_each_text(input)) as example,
 case when jsonb_array_length(expected)=0 then 'No matching result' else (select string_agg(kv.key || ': ' || kv.value,'; ') from jsonb_array_elements(expected) e cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(e) kv) end as expected_result
 from test_cases where rule_id=$1 order by name

name: change-review
title: Rule change review pack
for_each: select id,name from rules order by name

sections.title: Version history
sections.sql: select version,status,author,rationale,approver,approved_at from rule_versions where rule_id=$1 order by version

sections.title: Test evidence
sections.sql: select v.version,t.passed,t.actor,t.created_at,t.results from test_runs t join rule_versions v on v.id=t.version_id where v.rule_id=$1 order by t.created_at desc

sections.title: Unresolved exceptions
sections.sql: select summary,owner,due from exceptions where rule_id=$1 and resolved_at is null order by due

name: exception-review
title: Exception review sheet
for_each: select id,name from rules order by name

sections.title: Open and closed exceptions
sections.sql: select summary,owner,due,resolution,resolved_at from exceptions where rule_id=$1 order by due
